acceptance.item: P4-RT-12-02: npm run e2e fails in CI on every run: registry-weight.spec.ts reads built files by URL with the /<repo>/ base still in the path
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/registry-weight.spec.ts > every tool route and lesson fetches no other tool presets before interaction; site/tests/e2e/registry-weight.spec.ts > registry-weight.spec.ts reads the built files of island URLs without the /<repo>/ base in the path
acceptance.evidence: Severity: major as filed, raised to blocker by both verifiers. Red at base 967118d with the CI-base build: 1 failed, ENOENT site/dist/mutation_game/_astro/client.svelte.XNJPo5Ip.js. The new test was also red under a scratch revert to the old mapping (ENOENT .../mutation_game/_astro/client.js). Cause: the spec dropped only the leading slash of component-url and read site/dist hard-coded. It now uses siteAndBase(process.env).base and outDirFrom(process.env), as basepath.spec.ts does. Green: 3 passed at the CI base, 2 passed at root, and 35 passed at /sub/path/ with OUT_DIR=dist-basepath. I ran the whole suite once at the CI base: 881 passed, 6 failed. No other spec has this cause: four failures passed when rerun alone, and T15:537 fails at both bases. Commit 096c978.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-12-03: On Node 22.12 to 22.17, which engines and SPEC 7.1 admit, npm run build exits 1 (postbuild links.mjs), and npm run size and lab exit 1: plain node imports astro.config.mjs, which imports a .ts file
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/scripts-plain-node.test.ts > links.mjs, the postbuild of npm run build, checks a build (also > size.mjs reads the base and the built directory, > lab.mjs reads the base and the built directory)
acceptance.evidence: Red at base: 3 failed, 'links: Unknown file extension ".ts" for .../site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts', the same for size and lab. The test runs each script with --no-experimental-strip-types. Cause: the three scripts imported site/astro.config.mjs, which imports unverifiedRegistry.ts. siteAndBase, normaliseBase and outDirFrom moved unchanged into site/src/lib/siteAndBase.mjs, plain JavaScript; astro.config.mjs imports and re-exports them, so CONTRACTS 1 still holds. Green: 4 passed. On the official Node v22.12.0, npm run build exits 0 (links: 1040 internal links, 0 problems) and size.mjs exits 0 (32 routes, 0 over budget); lab.mjs gets past the import. engines and .nvmrc are unchanged. Commit ef1908e.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-12-04: npm run report presents the report of a release build that failed: the report is marked complete at astro:build:done, and postbuild's link check fails afterwards
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/links-release-report.test.ts > npm run report refuses the report of a release build that failed in postbuild (and 5 more cases)
acceptance.evidence: Red at base: 5 failed. checkOpenItemsReport accepted 'report: open items report of ...: 1 open items used on 1 pages, 0 unknown items' after links.mjs exited 1 with 1 problem. Cause: only astro:build:done set complete, and the postbuild never touched the report. In a release build links.mjs now first marks a completed report incomplete (linkCheck running), then marks it complete only when the check passes, else failed. It never completes a report the Astro build left incomplete. The build-done hook also marks the report incomplete when the process exits with a nonzero code after the hook. The report's file code moved unchanged to site/src/lib/openItemsReport.mjs, plain JavaScript. Green: 7 passed. The existing report-partial-release and content-components assertions still pass. On a copy of the branch, the lens's deadlink run gives release-build exit 1 and report exit 1 ('did not finish'). A clean release build gives report exit 0. Commit 5dba8f6.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-08-10: Attack 3 (e): the release report on standard error says E7 shows 'nothing' on M7, although the page shows the E7 fallback; gate G4's owner's part repeats it
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/unverified-report-lines.test.ts > a page whose later use of an item shows the fallback is reported as fallback shown (also > the line is decided per page: one page shows the fallback, another nothing)
acceptance.evidence: Red at base: 2 failed, 'open item E7 used on /modules/m7-geometry/ (nothing shown)'. Cause: registerUsage printed the line when a pair was first used. The registry now keeps the pages on which any use shows the fallback (the optional fallbackPages field, merged across module instances by build id). The build-done hook prints one line per (item, page). Green: 3 passed. A real RELEASE=1 build prints 'open item E7 used on /modules/m7-geometry/ (fallback shown)', and the lens's redteam-RT-08-p4-release-report.mjs reports 'every report line agrees with the release pages' (exit 0). reports/gate-G4.md section 11 still carries the old line; I did not edit any report. Commit a981786.

deviations.spec: P0-A4 instruction 5.8 (plan), DECISIONS P0-A4 'release mode, unknown items, and the open-items report'
deviations.what: The stderr line of an (item, page) pair is now printed by the build-done hook at the end of the build, not at the pair's first registration. One line per pair and the wording are unchanged. The report JSON gains two optional fields: fallbackPages (on items and unknownItems, present only when not empty) and linkCheck.
deviations.why: P4-RT-08-10 needs every use on the page before the line can be decided. P4-RT-12-04 needs the postbuild's state in the report. Neither shape is in CONTRACTS.md, and buildId and complete were added the same way before.

deviations.spec: cluster area (scripts/, unverifiedRegistry.ts, one browser test)
deviations.what: Changed site/astro.config.mjs (imports and re-exports the three functions) and added site/src/lib/siteAndBase.mjs and site/src/lib/openItemsReport.mjs.
deviations.why: The cause of P4-RT-12-03 is the import chain through astro.config.mjs (named in the finding's location). links.mjs needs the report-file code without TypeScript.

handoff: Outside the cluster: site/astro.config.mjs only re-exports siteAndBase, normaliseBase and outDirFrom from the new plain site/src/lib/siteAndBase.mjs, and site/src/lib/openItemsReport.mjs holds the report-file code that the registry used to hold. Request to MERGE (root package.json, for P4-RT-12-02): add the script "e2e:ci-base": "GITHUB_REPOSITORY=johnjanik/mutation_game npm run build && GITHUB_REPOSITORY=johnjanik/mutation_game playwright test". It leaves site/dist built at /mutation_game/. I did not follow the proposed --experimental-strip-types re-exec for P4-RT-12-03: the plain module takes the TypeScript out of the scripts entirely. (2) T02.spec.ts:522 reads '../../dist/' and ignores OUT_DIR; it does not fail in CI. (3) reports/gate-G4.md section 11 repeats the wrong E7 line, which GATE should correct.
